title: Up and down: every rocket launch since Sputnik, and where it all comes back
excerpt: I mapped all 7,416 orbital launch attempts since Sputnik from Jonathan McDowell's catalogue. The world launched a record 329 in 2025, more than half by SpaceX, and half of everything ever catalogued has already fallen back.
seo_description: A map of 7,416 orbital launches since 1957: the space race, the record 329 of 2025, the busiest spaceports and the Point Nemo graveyard.
header_alt: Title card reading 'Up and down' in red, black and blue on pale paper, beside a world map with circles for spaceports, big red ones at Plesetsk and Baikonur and blue ones in Florida and California, a dashed circle around Point Nemo in the South Pacific, and below it a stacked area chart of launches per year rising to 329 in 2025. Text: every orbital launch since Sputnik, 7,416 attempts.
